findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-parallel-wave.md overstates the shared JSON contract for the new parallel_* projections: the "Every JSON output includes" list claims all outputs carry storyRefs, hostCandidates, top-level evidenceRefs, and mergeOrder, but parallel_status, parallel_merge_queue, and parallel_report do not expose that envelope in implementation or smoke assertions. Tighten the section to distinguish the base wave/create/inspect/plan envelope from the projection-specific schemas, or enumerate each command separately.
